# WebPT

> WebPT is the leading AI-powered EMR and practice management platform purpose-built for physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology clinics.

WebPT provides an integrated suite of solutions including EMR documentation, billing and revenue cycle management, front office automation, marketing tools, and AI-assisted workflows. The platform serves rehab therapy practices of all sizes with HIPAA-compliant, interoperable software designed to streamline clinical documentation, improve patient outcomes, and accelerate revenue collection.

## Key Topics

- EMR (Electronic Medical Record)
- AI Documentation & Voice-to-Text
- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- HIPAA Compliance
- Patient Outcomes Tracking
- Home Exercise Programs (HEP)
- Telehealth & Virtual Visits
- Practice Management & Analytics
- Electronic Benefits Verification (eBV)
- MIPS Compliance & Quality Reporting
- Front Office Automation
- Digital Patient Intake
- Appointment Scheduling
- Patient Engagement
- Billing & Claims Management

## Core Platform & EMR

- [The Leading Physical Therapy Software & Rehab Therapy EMR | WebPT](https://www.webpt.com): WebPT homepage showcasing AI-powered EMR, billing, and marketing solutions for rehab therapy practices.
- [Physical Therapy EMR Software for Faster, Compliant Documentation | WebPT](https://www.webpt.com/products/emr): WebPT EMR software for PT, OT, and SLP with compliance and documentation automation.
- [Insight by WebPT | Integrated EMR and Billing for PT, OT, SLP](https://www.webpt.com/insight): Insight integrated EMR and billing platform for multi-specialty rehab clinic workflows.
- [AI Tools for Physical Therapy Documentation, Billing & Compliance | WebPT](https://www.webpt.com/rehab-ai): AI voice-to-text scribe and smart templates for rehab documentation, billing, and compliance.

## Clinical Documentation & Patient Outcomes

- [AI-Powered Documentation & Outcomes Tracking for Rehab Therapists | WebPT](https://www.webpt.com/documentation-patient-outcomes): AI-powered documentation and outcomes tracking tool for rehab therapists with patient engagement features.
- [WebPT Outcomes | Measure Progress, Improve Care, Prove Value](https://www.webpt.com/outcomes): WebPT Outcomes tool for real-time patient progress tracking and clinical performance measurement.
- [Home Exercise Program (HEP) Software for Rehab Therapy | WebPT](https://www.webpt.com/products/home-exercise-program): WebPT HEP tool for customizing and tracking patient home exercise programs and outcomes.
- [WebPT Virtual Visits | HIPAA-Compliant Telehealth for PT, OT, and SLP](https://www.webpt.com/products/virtual-visits): HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform with video, scheduling, and SOAP notes integration.
- [Keet by WebPT | Engage Patients & Improve Patient Outcomes](https://www.webpt.com/products/keet): Keet platform with home exercise tools, remote monitoring, outcomes tracking, and MIPS support.
